name: whatsapp-mcp
description: Search, read and (with full control) send your WhatsApp messages from Claude Code, through a bridge on your own computer. Read-only by default.

full_control.title: Full control (sending)
full_control.description: Offer the tools that send messages and reactions. Off by default: a message someone sends you can try to make Claude send for them (prompt injection). The bridge also needs full_control: yes in the configuration file.

config_file.title: Configuration file
config_file.description: The whatsapp-mcp configuration file (config.yaml), shared with the bridge. Leave empty for ~/.config/whatsapp-mcp/config.yaml.
